gaps.sentence: Only by chance ___ the letters discovered decades later.
gaps.explanation: 'Only by chance were the letters discovered' — inverted passive.

gaps.sentence: Little ___ anyone realise how close the firm was to insolvency.
gaps.explanation: "Little did anyone realise" = nobody realised — emphatic inversion with do-support.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last vote had been counted ___ the returning officer speak.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when' at the front forces question order: did the returning officer speak.

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the pilot leave the cockpit.
gaps.explanation: At no point did… = never did… — negative adverbial inversion.

gaps.sentence: Such ___ the chaos at the airport that hundreds slept on the terminal floor.
gaps.explanation: 'Such was the chaos that…' — emphatic fronting of 'such' with inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only after the audit ___ the missing funds come to light.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after the audit did the funds come to light'.

gaps.sentence: So widespread ___ the outage that servers abroad noticed.
gaps.explanation: So widespread was the outage that… — inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only when she apologised ___ he agree to meet again.
gaps.explanation: Only when she apologised did he agree — inversion.
